statement: The Phase 11 decision rules: which governed evidence makes an opportunity TRADE, WATCH or AVOID, how each section is filled and ordered, and what every gate does with a missing input. Every rule is a POLICY choice proposed for independent review. None is learned, fitted, optimized or statistically validated, and no rule assigns an expected return.

precedence.rationale: A known disqualifier (a FAIL gate) makes AVOID; otherwise any capped or missing authority makes WATCH; only when every mandatory gate passes is it TRADE. Unknown never becomes TRADE.

max_state_by_type.rationale: Only a governed strategy signal can be TRADE. An emerging observation has no strategy authority, and a funding spread has no research authority for its persistence and no portfolio hedge model, so both are capped at WATCH.

trade_identity.rationale: v8.identity/4 crypto execution identity. Every other state (VERIFIED_TRADFI, UNVERIFIED, AMBIGUOUS, none) is AVOID for every opportunity type: identity is never inferred from a ticker, a price, a score or a venue label.

conflict_flags.rationale: Conflicting economic evidence or a ticker collision is an affirmative exposure disqualifier: AVOID.

degraded_flags.rationale: An exposure check that did not run cleanly is missing authority: at most WATCH.

healthy_data_quality.rationale: The discovery record's data quality; DATA_DEGRADED (a contract with a non-healthy value) is missing authority, at most WATCH. A degraded or fallback discovery is missing authority for every candidate.

max_age_s.rationale: A strategy signal is current until its next bar would have closed, plus one hour for late scans (4h: 4h + 1h; 1d: 24h + 1h). An older signal is stale: AVOID.

max_stop_fraction.rationale: A signal's stop distance must be a fraction in (0, 0.5); anything else is an invalid signal (AVOID). quant.py's own stop bounds are tighter and unchanged.

trade_deployment_states.rationale: Phase 9 deployment authority sufficient for TRADE (it already requires research_state REQUALIFIED and a reviewed promotion).

trade_research_states.rationale: Phase 9 research authority sufficient for TRADE.

watch_deployment_states.rationale: Runtime continuity is not research authority: a LEGACY_HOLDOVER or paper-only signal is at most WATCH, blocker STRATEGY_RESEARCH_AUTHORITY_INSUFFICIENT.

avoid_deployment_states.rationale: A disabled strategy cannot create a directional opportunity: AVOID.

avoid_research_states.rationale: A rejected or invalidated research state is an affirmative disqualifier whatever the deployment state.

effects.rationale: The v8.liquidity execution gate of the discovery record decides; below the gate can still be WATCHed (never TRADE), missing liquidity is never liquid, and a coin not listed on a trade DEX cannot be acted upon.

venue_rule.rationale: A directional proposal pays the most adverse current rate observed on any trade-DEX contract of its admitted exposure (the venue is the human's choice). The venue, its reported interval and its receive time are kept.

max_rate_age_s.rationale: A funding observation received more than an hour before the decision is not current.

max_input_age_s.rationale: Discovery, the quant inputs and the portfolio must all be from this scan (within an hour of the decision time).

after_state_effects.rationale: The Phase 10 what_if after-state of the proposed position against the whole open book. APPROACHING_LIMITS is capped at WATCH (conservative: no existing evidence justifies trading into the approach band).

evidence_from_flags.rationale: Discovery research flags (observational, v8.discovery/1) used as positive evidence. NEW_LISTING is first seen by this desk after tracking started, never a listing date: it is RECENTLY_OBSERVED_BY_DESK, not NEWLY_LISTED.

primary_evidence.rationale: An emerging candidate needs at least one primary item: a current enabled-strategy signal whose own decision is WATCH, a market first seen by the desk recently, or a 24h move of at least 15% either way.

warning_flags.rationale: Flags reported as warnings; never positive evidence.

holding_hours.rationale: The carry is projected over this horizon at the current observed rates; rates change, so it is a projection, not an expectation.

max_basis.rationale: The two legs' prices per coin must be within 0.5% of their mean, else the basis risk dominates the carry: AVOID.

min_net_carry.rationale: The projected carry after four taker fills and both legs' slippage must be positive.

leg_volume_threshold.rationale: Each leg's own venue 24h volume must meet the discovery record's execution-liquidity threshold (the scanner's legacy minimum; never a second copy of the number).

best_trades_now.rationale: Up to five TRADE opportunities, never a minimum: a WATCH is never promoted to fill it.

emerging_opportunities.rationale: Up to five WATCH emerging observations with primary evidence and no affirmative disqualifier.

funding_opportunities.rationale: Up to five FUNDING_SPREAD_OPPORTUNITY candidates whose spread survives costs and basis; never called risk-free arbitrage.

best_trades_now.rationale: After every gate: a new signal before an already-active one, fresher first, cheaper execution tier, smaller portfolio risk after the addition, then a deterministic tie-break. No volume, market cap or popularity input.

emerging_opportunities.rationale: More distinct governed evidence first, then closer to trade-ready (fewer outstanding blockers), then a deterministic tie-break. No volume, market cap or popularity input.

funding_opportunities.rationale: Larger projected carry after costs first, then smaller basis, then a deterministic tie-break.
